cycle.claim_boundary: An accepted result is a binary64 one-step residual holdout on one 17x17 forced endpoint, 32 independent directions and five registered amplitudes. It does not regrade Q011e, prove a uniform Taylor remainder, continuous-amplitude family, forced SSM existence or uniqueness, nonlinear normal attraction or a basin, evaluate TT compression, or cover other grids, forces or wall boundaries.
